flows:
Navigate to https://app.uniswap.org/swap then Do not connect a wallet or sign anything.
Never press 'Connect wallet', 'Review', 'Approve and swap' or any confirm button.
Select the first token drop-down and choose ETH on the Ethereum network.
Then select the second token drop-down and choose ETH on the Base network.
Enter 0.01 in the amount box.
Assert that the page shows an amount of ETH to receive on Base.

summary:
The page was in the requested cross-network swap state: 0.01 ETH was entered and the Buy field showed 0.00999713 ETH with the Base network badge. The final verification did not recognize that visible result, likely because it expected different text or did not interpret the network icon.
Update the final check to accept the populated Buy amount together with the ETH label and Base network badge/icon, rather than requiring a particular text layout.
one_liner: The receive amount was displayed for ETH on Base, but the final checker incorrectly reported that it was missing.
